import base64, hashlib, io, json, zipfile
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-gumroad-fit')
expected = '80b451146e7cdf45c3adada847d22dbe1dcaa8c192077cdf08b6d1fe323c6364'
index = root / 'director-rights-evidence-index.json'
result = {'expected_archive_sha256': expected, 'archive': None, 'members': [], 'rights_index_sha256': hashlib.sha256(index.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'decision': 'Hold redistribution and cohort licensing until the underlying provenance supports every payload file and the companion quickstart.'}
for candidate in sorted((root / 'private-exercise').rglob('*.b64')):
    try:
        payload = base64.b64decode(candidate.read_bytes())
    except ValueError:
        continue
    if hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() != expected:
        continue
    result['archive'] = str(candidate)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(payload)) as archive:
        for member in archive.infolist():
            if member.is_dir():
                continue
            data = archive.read(member)
            result['members'].append({'path': member.filename, 'size': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
    break
quickstart = root / 'private-exercise/delivery/quickstart-en-fr.md'
result['quickstart_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(quickstart.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if quickstart.is_file() else None
result['observation'] = 'Exact archive matched' if result['archive'] else 'No exact archive found among selected base64 inputs'
output = root / 'director-archive-rights-crosswalk-input.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
